title: Scan barcodes to log food
highlights: Android app: scan a product barcode from Home or Meals to look up food in FatSecret and jump straight to the serving step. Uses Google Play barcode scanning-no camera permission prompt.
Can't scan? Tap Type barcode instead and enter the UPC digits manually. If FatSecret doesn't have that product, use Search by name as before.

title: Easier meal logging
highlights: Add food by weight: enter grams or ounces (or pounds) and MyExercise figures out the serving for you-no more mental math on partial servings.
Serving size shows the label amount plus weight when FatSecret has it (for example, 1 1/2 cups and 39 g). Use Quick amount for common fractions like 1/2 or 1 1/2, or type a custom weight below.

title: Health Connect fixes
highlights: Importing from Health Connect only asks for read access-you won't be prompted to allow writing just to pull in a workout. MyExercise also no longer writes very short accidental exercise entries back to Health Connect.
